items.title: GTA 6 Skunk Ape questline walkthrough: All effigy locations and choices
items.summary: VGC's new guide covers the Skunk Ape questline, including every effigy location and whether to shoot Kirk or Mr Mangrove.

items.title: GTA 6's massive casino and sick go-kart track are currently closed, but I'm hoping we can trust those 'coming soon' signs
items.summary: A PC Gamer writer found the casino, a dog track and the Hot Skidz go-kart track locked even after finishing the story, and hopes they are teasers for post-launch single-player content.

items.title: This Strange GTA 6 Easter Egg Takes You to the Backrooms
items.summary: A hidden pill in a container north of Milport sends Jason into a strange Backrooms-style dimension, and a lot of real-world time passes while he's in it.

items.title: Sex in GTA 6 was extremely difficult to pull off, Rockstar says
items.summary: Rockstar's VP of animation says the team spent a lot of time and iteration on the intimacy between Jason and Lucia so it reacts to the state of their relationship.

items.title: GTA 6 Players Warned Not to Make Major Chapter 1 Mistake
items.summary: Players on the GTA 6 subreddit warn that you lose all your money and Jason's car at the end of Chapter 1, so grinding or upgrading before then is wasted effort.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Has Its First Plagiarism Accusation
items.summary: Fans say a custom SMG decal in GTA 6 is a flipped, traced copy of a 2021 illustration by the furry artist GabyT.

items.title: GTA 6 Players Think They've Found a South Park Easter Egg
items.summary: Players think a bar called Skeeter's in the Hamlet area of Leonida is a nod to the bar of the same name in South Park.

items.title: 'GTA 6': First Half-Hour Reveals Major Plot Twist Rockstar Has Managed to Keep Secret for Years
items.summary: The opening reveals that Jason and Lucia have a son, Tomas, who is in the custody of Lucia's aunt.

items.title: Binding Of Isaac Update Review-Bombed Over AI-Generated Music In GTA 6 Mode
items.summary: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ console update, which has a GTA-inspired Vice City seed that launched alongside GTA 6, was review-bombed after players found AI-generated music in it.

items.title: GTA 6 players report game-breaking crashes on PS5 and Xbox
items.summary: Players on PS5 and some on Xbox report repeated crashes, including error CE-108255-1 early in the story, and no official Rockstar patch has been announced.
